messages:
alex: Heads-up — draft for the Datadog + Redwood observability quickstart for Dedicated GPUs is ready for review: https://tiny.redwood/rd-datadog-quickstart . Looking to finalize on Wed. Thoughts?

marta: Nice! Quick question — are we including the OpenTelemetry collector config for our stream sampler? We should show the trace/span attributes to correlate token latency with model shard id.

sam: +1 for adding OTEL example. Also we need explicit instructions for Dedicated customers on ports and IAM roles. I can add a short checklist.

dd_liaison: Thanks for ping @alex — from Datadog side we can provide a dashboard bundle and a managed APM tag mapping script. Can we get sample logs/trace spans by EOD so our engineering PM can wire up the ingestion tests?

priya: I'll export a synthetic trace set from the staging Dedicated cluster and drop it in the shared drive. It will include: span.name=generate, attributes={model:gemini, batch_size:8, gpu_id:2}

eng_rhea: For the sample config, use this snippet for OTEL collector receivers:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
```
Also call out KV cache size and tokenization variation in the notes.

alex: Perfect. @dd_liaison — expect the artifact by 18:00 PT. Also, can Datadog confirm whether the marketplace listing requires an official bundle json vs their internal dashboard tar? We want the minimal path for a self-serve listing.

dd_liaison: Marketplace wants a dashboard bundle.json but we'll accept the tar for preview. We'll convert for listing once we validate metrics. :thumbsup: 

marta: Ops check — are there any special requirements for customers in EU region re: traces crossing regions? We should add a privacy note in the quickstart.

sam: Good catch. We'll add a snippet: `exporter.datadog.endpoint: dd.eu.datadoghq.com` and guidance to keep traces within customer VPC or use Private deployment.

priya: Uploaded sample traces here: https://drive.redwood/samples/dd-quickstart-traces-171980.zip

eng_rhea: Also adding a small Grafana-compatible panel JSON so SIs can pick it up. Will push to the repo under observability/templates.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch observability/rd-datadog-quickstart-docs — CI started (build 5123)

alex: Thanks team. Next steps: priya pushes traces, sam adds IAM checklist, marta drafts privacy paragraph, @dd_liaison will prepare dashboard bundle. Sync tomorrow 10am PT if needed. :calendar: 

dd_liaison: 10am PT works. See you all then.
